data.title: 'Everything Except Bitcoin Is Dead'? No, Watch ETH and SOL, Industry Veterans Say
data.description: Crypto industry veterans are skeptical of a revival for altcoins but argue that Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) and Solana (CRYPTO: SOL) remain among the few assets with compelling long-term cases.Is Everything Except Bitcoin Dead?Speaking with Milk Road, Electric Capital co-founder Avichal Garg pushed back…
